summary: LLVM: call_indirect is off with m0 optimization enabled
description:
### Summary

While working on a different issue, I noticed the current dispatching logic in `build_m0_indirect_call` is completely off for multiple reasons:

Dispatching logic is based on initial Table values at start of the module - these are subject to modifications at run-time With an exported table, other modules can modify it and insert functions local to those modules; this is problematic because such functions typically expect a different `m0` argument, so we would likely need a different kind of trampoline for this case.


### Details

The emitted code can crash at the run-time.

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

### Impact

An attacked might crash a run-time, or corrupt a data.
